components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary buy, save, continue, or recovery action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: 0 var(--space-4); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: var(--space-2); background: var(--color-brand-primary); color: #fff; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms ease, background 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(184, 134, 75, 0.45); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.6; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary action for admin, cart, filters, and checkout.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: 0 var(--space-4); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: var(--space-2); background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-brand-primary); font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms ease, background 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: rgba(201, 167, 109, 0.72); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(184, 134, 75, 0.45); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.6; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-emphasis action that should not compete with the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: 0 var(--space-4); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: transparent; color: var(--color-brand-primary); font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms ease, background 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(-1px); background: var(--color-surface-elevated); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(184, 134, 75, 0.45); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Compact square action with an accessible label.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-action" aria-label="Open menu"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M4 7h16M4 12h16M4 17h16"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-action { width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-text-primary); display: inline-grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, background 160ms ease; } .ds-icon-action:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: rgba(201, 167, 109, 0.72); } .ds-icon-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(184, 134, 75, 0.45); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Compact badge for neutral or semantic status.
components.css: .ds-status-badge { min-height: 24px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 999px; padding: 0 var(--space-3); font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); color: var(--color-text-secondary); background: transparent; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Default field for filters, checkout, and admin forms.
components.css: .ds-field-demo { display: grid; gap: var(--space-2); color: var(--color-text-secondary); font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-field-demo input { min-height: 44px; width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-text-primary); padding: 0 var(--space-3); font: inherit; } .ds-field-demo input::placeholder { color: var(--color-text-secondary); opacity: 0.78; } .ds-field-demo input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(184, 134, 75, 0.45); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Skeleton
components.description: Soft champagne loading layer that preserves layout.
components.css: .ds-skeleton-demo { display: block; width: 240px; min-height: 1rem; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: linear-gradient(90deg, #eee7dc, #faf6ef, #eee7dc); background-size: 220% 100%; animation: ds-demo-shimmer 1.4s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-demo-shimmer { to { background-position: -220% 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-skeleton-demo { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Bespoke should feel like a private buying gallery: predominantly white, highly controlled, with black as the authority signature and champagne gold as a rare mark of exclusivity. The admin interface provides the product discipline: clear components, crisp hierarchy, compact controls, readable panels, and predictable states. The storefront should inherit that confidence without becoming an admin screen.

The brand promise is luxury and exclusivity even when the surface is only a catalog. The customer should feel they are browsing a selective curation, not a handmade market or generic storefront. Give products room, remove rustic cues, avoid decorative texture, and let the future logo become the final source of truth for the black and champagne values.
keyCharacteristics: Predominantly white surfaces with warm tonal layers only where they separate content or state.
Near-black brand color for decisions, identity, admin authority, and primary actions.
Champagne gold as a rare signature for logo marks, active states, focus, and prestige details.
Compact, accessible, consistent components that bring admin discipline into the storefront.
Restrained luxury: less craft texture, less ornament, more space, rhythm, and confidence.

rules.name: The Champagne Restraint Rule
rules.body: Champagne gold is never a generic fill. If more than 10% of a screen is gold, the interface stops feeling exclusive and starts feeling themed.

rules.name: The White Gallery Rule
rules.body: White is the luxury here. Cream, sand, and craft-tinted backgrounds may appear as functional layers, never as the dominant atmosphere.

rules.name: The Display Discipline Rule
rules.body: Never use Cormorant for labels, inputs, buttons, tables, or controls. Product luxury comes from correct hierarchy, not applying the display font everywhere.

rules.name: The Gallery Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows should feel like gallery lighting, not floating boxes. If the shadow is more noticeable than the product, it is wrong.

dos: Do keep the storefront predominantly white, with black and champagne as brand and decision accents.
Do bring admin visual discipline into the storefront: consistent components, controlled spacing, clear buttons, and predictable states.
Do use Cormorant for editorial storefront moments and Inter for all task flows.
Do let products breathe. Catalog cards should feel curated, not handmade.
Do recalibrate `brand-primary` and `champagne-accent` when the final logo is added.
donts: Don't let the page feel artisanal, handmade, rustic, or market-stall-like. The brand must feel exclusive.
Don't use champagne gold as a broad background, decorative gradient, or texture. It is a rare signature.
Don't turn white into a dominant cream. Ivory is a functional layer, not the brand atmosphere.
Don't use thick side borders as accents on cards, alerts, or panels.
Don't split button vocabulary between admin and storefront. The same action must feel like the same family.
Don't apply large shadows to every card by default. Elevation needs a job.
